Khalid: Quick check  Rowan's birthday is next Mon. Two options: office balloons + mini cupcakes, or a $25 charity donation in their name (remote-friendly). Vote now.
Tess: Donation all the way. less waste and feels meaningful. :seedling:
Maya: Balloons are cute for photos though. Hybrid folks might miss out.
people-ops-bot: :ballot_box: Poll started  balloons 1, donation 1, undecided 0
Riku: Donation. also can post a celebratory GF cookie in the office for onsite folks.
Khalid: Good idea  hybrid compromise: donation + small GF treat on site. Budget for donation $25, treats $40. OK?
Ava: Love it. Also note: one remote teammate is in EU, need to confirm donation service accepts EUR.
Tess: I can check CharityList.org — most accept multi-currency.
people-ops-bot: :memo: Reminder created: "Confirm charity payment method" scheduled for 1923460000.
Maya: Photo plan: quick 30-sec video from onsite folks and a digital card link in #general. @Ava can you make the card?
Ava: Yep will create a collaborative card. Link will be posted here.
Tess: Confirmed CharityList accepts EUR. Can do $25 USD equivalent or EUR 22. Will proceed if donation wins.
Khalid: Final tally donation 4, balloons 1. Donation + GF office cookie it is. I'll send donation receipt to people-ops for records.
people-ops-bot: :tada: Thread closed  plan=donation+onsite-treat, budget_total=$65, owner=Khalid
Riku: Thanks team! :)
Khalid: Thanks everyone :party_parrot:
